name: hinge-profile-optimizer
description: Comprehensive, research-backed Hinge dating profile optimization. Audits an existing profile, runs a discovery interview, writes prompts and captions, orders photos strategically, and gives post-launch algorithm strategy. Grounded in peer-reviewed behavioral research (Toma, Donath, Bruch & Newman) and signaling theory, not vibes. Activate on 'hinge profile', 'dating profile help', 'why am I not getting matches', 'dating app photo order'. NOT for a quick one-line prompt fix (full process runs ~45 min), other dating apps without adaptation, or general dating coaching outside profile scope.
